claims.claim_text: Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities is assigned to the entity’s governance body(ies) and/or designated individual(s) charged with governance.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities (opening paragraph)
claims.support_notes: Text states oversight is assigned to governance body(ies)/designated individuals, aligning with requirement to identify responsible body/individual(s). Specific names/identifiers are not provided in the draft.

claims.claim_text: Responsibilities for oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities are reflected in applicable terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions and related policies for the governance body(ies) and/or individual(s).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities (opening paragraph)
claims.support_notes: Directly addresses reflection of responsibilities in governance documentation; does not cite or reference specific documents.

claims.claim_text: The governance body(ies) and/or individual(s) oversee sustainability-related and climate-related matters by determining whether appropriate skills and competencies are available (or will be developed) to oversee strategies responding to these risks and opportunities.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight... (bullet: skills and competencies)
claims.support_notes: Matches the skills/competencies disclosure element; draft does not describe how the determination is performed.

claims.claim_text: The governance body(ies) and/or individual(s) receive information about sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities, including the manner and frequency with which such information is provided.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight... (bullet: receiving information; manner and frequency)
claims.support_notes: Addresses that information is received and references manner/frequency, but does not specify actual cadence or channels.

claims.claim_text: The governance body(ies) and/or individual(s) take sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities into account when overseeing the entity’s strategy, decisions on major transactions, and risk management processes and related policies, including consideration of relevant trade-offs.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight... (bullet: strategy/transactions/risk management; trade-offs)
claims.support_notes: Aligns with requirement to explain how risks/opportunities are considered in oversight; draft remains high-level without examples or decision criteria.

claims.claim_text: The governance body(ies) and/or individual(s) oversee the setting of targets related to sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities and monitor progress towards those targets, including whether and how related performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight... (bullet: targets, monitoring, remuneration linkage)
claims.support_notes: Covers targets/progress monitoring and remuneration linkage conceptually; no specific targets, metrics, or remuneration mechanisms are disclosed.

claims.claim_text: Management is responsible for the governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: States management responsibility for processes/controls/procedures; does not detail specific controls or governance processes.

claims.claim_text: Management’s role includes delegation of responsibilities to a specific management-level position and/or management-level committee, with oversight exercised through management reporting and escalation to the governance body(ies) and/or designated individual(s).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Management’s role (bullet: delegation; reporting/escalation)
claims.support_notes: Addresses delegation and oversight mechanism at a general level; does not identify the position/committee or describe reporting frequency.

claims.claim_text: Management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities, integrated with relevant internal functions.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Management’s role (bullet: controls/procedures integrated with internal functions)
claims.support_notes: Meets the disclosure element that controls/procedures are used and integrated; draft does not specify which controls or which internal functions.
